import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_ts = pd.to_datetime(seed_time)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    # --- История продаж строго до seed_time ---
    hist_items = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) &
        (order_items["ts"] < seed_ts)
    ].copy()

    # Берём из orders только то, что известно на момент seed_time:
    # дата покупки и оценка доставки (известна сразу после покупки).
    # order_status и даты доставки/одобрения НЕ используем напрямую:
    # они отражают состояние на момент выгрузки, а не на seed_time.
    hist_items = pd.merge(
        hist_items,
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    hist_items["total_value"] = hist_items["price"] + hist_items["freight_value"]

    # --- Агрегаты за всю историю ---
    g = hist_items.groupby("product_id")
    features["total_units"] = g.size()
    features["total_revenue"] = g["total_value"].sum()
    features["avg_price"] = g["price"].mean()
    features["avg_freight"] = g["freight_value"].mean()
    features["max_price"] = g["price"].max()
    features["min_price"] = g["price"].min()
    features["unique_orders"] = g["order_id"].nunique()
    features["unique_sellers"] = g["seller_id"].nunique()
    features["units_per_order"] = features["total_units"] / features["unique_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- Окна активности ---
    last_sale = g["ts"].max()
    first_sale = g["ts"].min()
    features["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_ts - last_sale).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    features["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_ts - first_sale).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    features["days_since_last_sale"] = features["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(730)
    features["days_since_first_sale"] = features["days_since_first_sale"].fillna(730)

    for win_days in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        w = hist_items[hist_items["ts"] >= seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=win_days)]
        gw = w.groupby("product_id")
        features[f"units_{win_days}d"] = gw.size()
        features[f"revenue_{win_days}d"] = gw["total_value"].sum()
        features[f"orders_{win_days}d"] = gw["order_id"].nunique()

    # Тренд: продажи последних 90 дней против предыдущих 90
    prev = hist_items[
        (hist_items["ts"] >= seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=180)) &
        (hist_items["ts"] < seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=90))
    ].groupby("product_id").size()
    recent = hist_items[hist_items["ts"] >= seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby("product_id").size()
    features["trend_90_90"] = recent / prev.replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- Оценка доставки (известна на момент покупки) ---
    est_delay = (hist_items["order_estimated_delivery_date"] -
                 hist_items["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    features["avg_estimated_delivery_days"] = est_delay.groupby(hist_items["product_id"]).mean()

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы до seed_time ---
    relevant_order_ids = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]["order_id"].unique()
    rev = pd.merge(
        reviews[reviews["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids)],
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    rev = rev[rev["review_creation_date"] < seed_ts]

    gr = rev.groupby("product_id")
    features["review_count"] = gr.size()
    features["avg_review_score"] = gr["review_score"].mean()
    features["min_review_score"] = gr["review_score"].min()
    high = rev[rev["review_score"] >= 4].groupby("product_id").size()
    low = rev[rev["review_score"] <= 2].groupby("product_id").size()
    features["high_score_share"] = high / features["review_count"].replace(0, np.nan)
    features["low_score_share"] = low / features["review_count"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Свежесть отзывов
    last_review = gr["review_creation_date"].max()
    features["days_since_last_review"] = (seed_ts - last_review).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    features["days_since_last_review"] = features["days_since_last_review"].fillna(730)

    # --- Платежи: только по заказам, совершённым до seed_time ---
    pay = pd.merge(
        payments[payments["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids)],
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    pay = pay[pay["ts"] < seed_ts]

    gp = pay.groupby("product_id")
    features["avg_installments"] = gp["payment_installments"].mean()
    total_pay = gp["payment_value"].sum()
    card_pay = pay[pay["payment_type"] == "credit_card"].groupby("product_id")["payment_value"].sum()
    features["card_payment_share"] = card_pay / total_pay.replace(0, np.nan)
    seq_max = pay.groupby(["product_id", "order_id"])["payment_sequential"].max()
    features["avg_payments_per_order"] = seq_max.groupby("product_id").mean()

    # --- Финальная очистка ---
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    return features.astype(float)
